annotations.title: Find a guard that lifts the odds

description: Retests a trader's own closed trades on up to three accounts with a daily stop at several levels and with a cap of one to three trades a day (guards the PropPassCheck strategy builder can add to an EA, or a trader can follow by hand), and reports the one that lifts the chance of passing (or of a first payout on instant accounts) the most, with how much and a link to build it. Needs real trades with starting_balance; give dates when known so each day's trades stay together.

starting_balance.description: The balance the trades started from.

trades.description: Closed trades in the order they closed.

date.description: Close date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give it for every trade or for none.

profit.description: Profit (positive) or loss (negative) in account currency, after costs.

trades_per_day.description: Only used when the trades have no dates. Default 2.

name: fix_strategy
title: Find a guard that lifts the odds
